messages:
IncidentBot: Pager — Billing telemetry anomaly detected for emitter group 'us-west-emitters'. Sudden burst of delayed emits + duplicate reconciliation causing token-count drift and customer overage flags. Alerts: billing.alerts.count-drift, billing.alerts.delayed-emit. Triggered 2026-03-17T14:02:12Z. Sev: P2. Paging @carla-oncall.

Carla Oncall: taking this. Linking incident INC-2026-1145. Can someone post current span of affected customers?

Ben Billing: seeing increased tail latency in emitter writeback. Window stitching job lagged ~7m -> batched replays. Affected customers: corpA (partial), corpB (full). Overages firing for corpB. Snapshot: tokens emitted +12% vs expected.

Emily Support: corpB just opened an SR, they got an overage email. I'll start a provisional support thread and draft a customer-facing note.

Alice SRE: quick mitigation plan: 1) mute billing alerting temporarily (shadow counts continue) 2) force emitter drain for us-west 3) flip metering to 'shadow-agg' to recompute counts from raw stream 4) start backfill for impacted windows.

Dave Infra: taking drain. Running:
```
sudo systemctl stop emitter-writer && /opt/emit/drain.sh --group us-west-emitters --safe
```
ETA ~3m.

Dave Infra: drain complete, replay queue at 0. Muted billing alerts. Kicking off shadow-agg recompute job now.

Ben Billing: shadow counts coming in — deltas are converging. corpB overflag reduced from 3 -> 0 after swap to shadow-agg. Reports will still be delayed while backfill runs. Recommend suppressing customer overage emails and issuing provisional credit hold until backfill completes.

Emily Support: drafted customer message: "We detected a billing telemetry issue affecting usage reporting for some customers between 14:00–14:10 UTC. We are recomputing usage and will update within 2 hours. No action required; any overage emails are erroneous." Requesting signoff.

Carla Oncall: +1 to message. Approve send once final deltas confirmed. Emily, own customer comms. Ben, post backfill job id and ETA.

Ben Billing: backfill started id bf-4098761. ETA ~95min for corpB (large tenant). Monitoring logs; current token delta trending toward baseline. Long-term fix: add rate limit and sanity-checks to window stitcher.

Alice SRE: adding a 20m suppression window for billing alerts and opening PR to add emitter window-tail metrics. Also filing a follow-up ticket to add canary for stitcher replays.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-1145 updated — mitigations in place. Please follow up with a postmortem and impact assessment (billing export + customer list).

Carla Oncall: closing the pager for now. We'll monitor for 1h and confirm final reconciled counts before sending a final customer update. Thanks everyone. :clap:

Emily Support: will hold draft and post final message after bf-4098761 completes.

Ben Billing: will post reconciliation summary (CSV) and final token deltas when backfill finishes.

Alice SRE: monitoring dashboards show token-count drift returning to normal after shadow swap. Marking mitigation successful so far.

Carla Oncall: if anything worsens re-open pager. Otherwise next steps: postmortem, credits if needed, stitcher hardening. Closing thread.
